description.zh:
for 迴圈

前面的程式多半逐行依序執行；當同一段程式需要重複多次時，就要用到迴圈。C++ 有 for 與 while，本章先學 for。

最基本的 for 由三部分組成：初始值、條件、每次迭代後的更新：

for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    cout <<(i);
}
// 0
// 1
// 2

若要讓 i 從 5 跑到 7（不含 8），可寫：

for (int i = 5; i < 8; i++) {
    cout <<(i + " " + (i * i));
}
// 5 25
// 6 36
// 7 49

上界常寫成 i < n + 1 或 i <= n，才能包含 n 本身。例如求 1 到 n 的和：

int result = 0;
int n = 5;
for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    result += i;
}
cout <<(result);  // 15

遞減迴圈

需要由大到小迭代時，可在更新步驟減去固定值：

for (int i = 10; i > 0; i -= 2) {
    cout <<(i);
}
// 10
// 8
// 6
// 4
// 2

若起始條件一開始就不成立（例如 i < -5 且初值為 0），迴圈本體一次都不會執行。

輸出格式

預設 cout <<(x) 會在末尾換行。若要在同一行連續輸出多個值，可用 cout <<：

cout <<(1);
cout <<(" ");
cout <<(2);  // 1 2 然後換行

本章題目包含階乘、累加、階梯輸出與數列列印等，請善用 for 控制重複次數與迭代變數。閱讀完畢後，點選「下一題」開始練習。
description.en:
The for loop

Earlier programs ran line by line. When a block must run many times, use a loop. Java has for and while; this chapter covers for.

A basic for has three parts: initialization, condition, and update:

for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    cout <<(i);
}
// 0
// 1
// 2

To iterate from 5 to 7 inclusive of 5 but stop before 8:

for (int i = 5; i < 8; i++) {
    cout <<(i + " " + (i * i));
}
// 5 25
// 6 36
// 7 49

Often write the bound as i <= n to include n. Sum from 1 to n:

int result = 0;
int n = 5;
for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    result += i;
}
cout <<(result);  // 15

Descending loops

for (int i = 10; i > 0; i -= 2) {
    cout <<(i);
}
// 10
// 8
// 6
// 4
// 2

If the condition is false at the start, the loop body never runs.

Output formatting

cout << adds a newline. To print several values on one line, use cout <<:

cout <<(1);
cout <<(" ");
cout <<(2);

Problems include factorials, sums, ladder output, and printing sequences—use for to control repetition. When ready, click Next below.
